purpose: Test whether the current post-exposure/pre-uptake evidence localization has actionable engineering value by changing only the policy-integration surface after retrieval while holding the upstream memory and retrieved packet fixed.
not_a_method_claim: The treatment is a falsification probe for diagnostic actionability, not a claimed novel memory-utilization algorithm.

prior_frozen_signature.write: SUPPORTED: 20/20 Shopping pairs diverge; same-mode excess 0.105, p=0.0078

engineering_principle_under_test.name: stage-indexed credit and repair

credit_rule.meaning: The update changed persistent state; do not infer retrieval, policy use, or utility.
The branch-conditioned source item reached the policy context; do not infer policy use.
A matched downstream decision contrast is supported; this is the earliest stage at which behavioral self-improvement credit may be considered.
The behavioral change has a supported downstream utility consequence in the tested regime; sign and heterogeneity remain part of the claim.

engineering_principle_under_test.repair_rule: Treat the first unsupported measured native stage after supported/observed prerequisites as a repair hypothesis, not a causal fact. Target that surface with a prospective single-factor intervention while freezing upstream stages; if the predicted stage does not move despite verified intervention realization, the diagnosis has not earned actionable repair authority.

scientific_question: Does a post-retrieval policy-integration intervention selectively increase branch-specific first-action uptake when write and retrieved memory content are held fixed, as predicted by the current stage-resolved diagnosis?

competing_hypotheses.prediction: A memory-use binding intervention increases the branch-specific first-action contrast relative to both native and wording-placebo controls while the exact retrieved memory packet is identical across prompt arms. If uptake rises, terminal behavior may be tested as the next stage without retroactively changing the diagnosis.
Any extra policy instruction, including a semantics-neutral wording placebo, changes first-action behavior similarly; an apparent gain is prompt sensitivity rather than targeted memory uptake.

Even after verified post-retrieval integration manipulation, the treatment-specific first-action contrast does not increase; the existing boundary remains descriptive evidence localization and does not predict a usable repair surface.

design.unit: Frozen Shopping branch-comparison state with a recoverable, content-addressed native retrieved-memory packet and matched success/failure branch inputs.
design.selection: Eligibility is determined only from pre-existing frozen retrieval artifacts and packet integrity, before any new policy output is generated. No selection may use prior or new task outcome, effect magnitude, or action difference.
required_preexecution_inventory: exact retrieved memory packet and ordering for each branch
content hashes for all frozen inputs

arms.change: insert the exact fixed clause after CURRENT BROWSER STATE and before the native action instruction
arms.clause: Before choosing the next action, explicitly assess whether the ULTIMATE TASK and CURRENT BROWSER STATE together change which action should be taken. If this check is relevant, incorporate it; otherwise proceed as usual. Do not add explanation.
arms.purpose: control generic additional decision-check instruction and salience without mentioning reusable memory

arms.change: insert the exact fixed clause at the same position as A1
arms.clause: Before choosing the next action, explicitly assess whether the REUSABLE MEMORY and CURRENT BROWSER STATE together change which action should be taken. If this check is relevant, incorporate it; otherwise proceed as usual. Do not add explanation.
arms.purpose: target the exposure-to-uptake integration surface while matching A1 syntax and decision-check structure

forbidden_changes: retriever, retrieval k, retrieval ranking, or memory order
task subset after seeing new outcomes

stage_realization_checks.W_invariant: No writer call is made; use pre-existing content-addressed branch memories.
stage_realization_checks.E_invariant: No retriever call is made in the policy experiment; replay the exact frozen retrieved packet byte-for-byte across A0/A1/A2 for each branch.
stage_realization_checks.U_manipulated_surface: The only intended treatment variable is policy-side integration instruction A0/A1/A2.
stage_realization_checks.O_secondary: Terminal outcome is secondary and must not be used to define or tune the uptake treatment.

requirements: load one eligible frozen state without network/provider execution
verify A0/A1/A2 packet equality outside the integration clause
verify per-case output/log paths are append-safe and resume-capable
verify first-action parser on archived outputs
write run manifest before any provider/model execution

pilot.sample_rule: Freeze a small outcome-blind subset from eligible states using task IDs or a predeclared hash-based selection rule; do not choose cells because prior forced/native effects were large.
pilot.primary_endpoint: paired change in branch-specific first-action contrast under A2 versus A0 and A1
pilot.terminal_endpoint: exploratory/secondary until uptake manipulation is realized and adjudicated
go_full_only_if: A1 memory-blind decision check does not absorb the A2 memory-use-check effect
the first-action observable shows discriminative signal sufficient for an interpretable full test
per-case artifacts and resume/replay paths are complete

full.unlock_requires: qualified pilot plus explicit authority plus frozen inference/power contract

adjudication.A2_gt_A0_and_A1_at_U_with_packet_invaria: SUPPORTS_ACTIONABLE_REPAIR_PREDICTION_AT_UPTAKE; does not yet prove utility improvement
adjudication.A2_equals_A1_or_both_move: GENERIC_DECISION_CHECK_SENSITIVITY_OR_INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY_SPECIFICITY; do not claim targeted uptake repair
adjudication.A2_realized_but_U_not_moved: NARROW current result to descriptive evidence localization; stage diagnosis did not predict an actionable repair on this intervention
adjudication.U_moves_but_O_does_not: boundary shifts downstream for engineering purposes; target action quality/task alignment next rather than more retrieval
adjudication.U_and_O_move: supports diagnosis-guided repair utility on the tested substrate only; requires replication before broad memory-governance claims

after_run: claim update and failure differential diagnosis

not_claimed: generic memory management or RL optimization
novelty_boundary.claimed_if_validated: A stage-resolved persistent-update diagnosis can be translated into stage-indexed self-improvement credit and can prospectively predict which repair surface should be intervened on while upstream stages remain fixed.
